name: Virtual Multi-Resolution Volume with Page Table Hierarchy
aliases: Virtual Memory Architecture for Volume Rendering
definition: A virtual memory architecture for out-of-core volume visualization that replaces tree structures (octrees/kD-trees) with a virtual multi-resolution volume addressed via normalized coordinates and translated to physical cache blocks via a hierarchy of page tables.
summary: A virtual memory architecture for out-of-core volume rendering that replaces explicit trees with a recursive page table hierarchy, enabling efficient address translation for arbitrary, axis-dependent resolution levels.
